title: Manorama Industries Limited (NSE: MANORAMA) — Specialty Fats & CBE Compounder Underwriting Dossier
primer: Manorama Industries is India's largest maker of Cocoa Butter Equivalents (CBE) and exotic specialty fats. Q2 FY27 sales rose 41.9% YoY to ₹458.86 Cr at 25.8% OPM, keeping our business grade at COMPOUNDER_PASS with a watch flag. Pass 1 patched the Nov 12 Board exit of founders Ashish Ramesh Saraf and Vinita Ashish Saraf to MD Deep Saraf, a ₹20.64 Cr Customs deposit, Manorama Africa RPTs, and ₹350 Cr Burkina Faso commitments. Shares sit in Stage 3 at ₹1,842.40 (2026-11-23 ledger) and ₹1,859.90 (2026-11-25 live TV), above our capacity-bridged ₹1,800 Base Target, so new capital is REJECTED. We trim 45 of 135 held shares (TRIM_OVERWEIGHT) near ₹1,842–₹1,860 and hold 90 core shares behind our locked ₹1,664.00 daily-close stop.
holding_rationale: You hold 135 shares in Zerodha at ₹1,856.11 avg cost (₹2,50,574.20 cost; 5.83% weight on the 2026-11-23 NSE ledger at ₹1,842.40). At 2026-11-25 live TV (₹1,859.90), value is ₹2,51,086.50 (+0.20%). Because shares slipped into Stage 3 below the 50D SMA while capacity-bridged Base value sits at ₹1,800, we tighten to TRIM_OVERWEIGHT. Trim 45 shares (~33%) near ₹1,842–₹1,860 to free ~₹83.7k cash and cut weight to ~3.85%–3.89% ahead of the founder transition, ₹20.64 Cr Customs inquiry, ₹518 Cr H1 debt, and ₹350 Cr Sahel spend. Hold the remaining 90 core shares behind our locked ₹1,664.00 daily-close hard stop, cutting open stop risk to 0.41% of NAV.
